caption: What if a whale swallowed you? Most whales simply can't. A humpback's mouth opens about 3 m wide, but its throat is roughly fist-sized and stretches to only about 38 cm. In 2021 a humpback accidentally scooped up a lobster diver off the US coast. After about 30 seconds in the dark it surfaced and spat him out, and he survived. Of about 90 whale species, only the sperm whale has a throat big enough for a person. It grows to about 20 m, dives more than 3 km deep and hunts giant squid. Squid beaks can't be digested, and in some sperm whales the gut coats them in a waxy lump called ambergris. Plot twist: 'whale vomit' mostly comes out the other end, and fresh it smells like poop. Perfumers prize it, but sperm whales are protected in India and selling ambergris is illegal. Would YOU swim near a whale? 👇
